road.title: Saying hello
road.description: A stooped and careful soul in a coat with more pockets than the law requires, next to a small bell marked RING FOR ATTENTION and a larger one marked DO NOT. Marigold is a Census Taker and has been counting the people on this road since before it was a road and is missing exactly one.

openObjectives.prompt: Marigold is plainly waiting to be greeted and will not be the one to start. Greet Marigold, using Italian.
Marigold looks like someone with a great deal to report on the subject of how they are. Ask Marigold how they are, using Italian.
Marigold has other people to be greeted by. Say goodbye to Marigold, using Italian.

character.name: Marigold Oddfellow
character.description: A stooped and careful soul in a coat with more pockets than the law requires, next to a small bell marked RING FOR ATTENTION and a larger one marked DO NOT. Marigold is a Census Taker and has been counting the people on this road since before it was a road and is missing exactly one.

npc.narrative: It is a quiet pomeriggio at the Forgotten Dell, and the cielo is clear enough to be sospetto. Marigold Oddfellow sits on a sedia beside the strada, a libro open on one knee and a timbro waiting on the other. She looks up, calm, like a woman who has counted tutti but uno.
npc.native: Salve! Io sono Marigold. Conto le persone sulla strada. Come stai?
npc.translation: Hello! I am Marigold. I count the people on the road. How are you?

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely start! You greeted Marigold and said you were well, all in correct Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, you greeted Marigold with a correct Italian greeting.
You answered Marigold's question nicely, but this step wants you to ask Marigold how she is. Marigold will give you another chance to do it later.
This step wants you to say goodbye to Marigold. Marigold will bring it up again later.

openObjectives.prompt: Marigold looks like someone with a great deal to report on the subject of how they are. Ask Marigold how they are, using Italian.
Marigold has other people to be greeted by. Say goodbye to Marigold, using Italian.

npc.narrative: You stand on the strada while Marigold writes a numero in a very old libro. The sole is out, the cielo is clear, and the timbro on the tavolo waits, unused, for a good reason.
npc.native: Bene, bene! Anche io sto bene. Una persona in più. Come va oggi?
npc.translation: Good, good! I am well too. One more person. How is it going today?

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely answer! You said you are well, asked Marigold back, and used \"Come stai?\" correctly.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, you asked Marigold how they are with "Come stai?".
You haven't said goodbye to Marigold yet; that will come up again later, so say a farewell when you are ready.

openObjectives.prompt: Marigold has other people to be greeted by. Say goodbye to Marigold, using Italian.

npc.narrative: The cielo is clear and the sole is warm. Marigold holds her timbro over a pagina of her libro, looks at you, and puts it down again, molto calmly. The strada is quiet, and she counts it ancora.
npc.native: Io sto bene, grazie! Ora conto le persone sulla strada. Arrivederci, a presto! Va bene?
npc.translation: I am well, thank you! Now I count the people on the road. Goodbye, see you soon! Is that all right?

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely! You agreed with Marigold and said goodbye to her in Italian. Just remember the accent on \"Sì\" when you mean yes.

objectiveResults.feedback: You said goodbye to Marigold in Italian with "Arrivederci", well done.

npc.narrative: Marigold writes you into her libro with un piccolo segno, poi pats the timbro in her tasca. Under the clear sole of the pomeriggio, the strada goes on in both directions, ma you are, by her count, one more.
npc.native: Arrivederci! Grazie, sei una persona in più. A presto!
npc.translation: Goodbye! Thank you, you are one person more. See you soon!

npc.narrative: You stand on the strada while Marigold writes in her registro with a short matita. The timbro stays in its pocket, un po' hopeful, as it has since the ninth reorganisation. Il cielo is clear, and she adds you to the column without looking up.
npc.native: Prego! Una persona in più è una buona cosa. Come stai adesso?
npc.translation: You're welcome! One more person is a good thing. How are you now?

npc.narrative: Marigold lowers her matita and studies the cielo, which is entirely chiaro. In her grande registro she makes a small segno beside your nome, then glances at the timbro in her tasca, which still has no motivo.
npc.native: Molto bene, che bello! Oggi la strada è bella e il cielo è chiaro. Sei felice?
npc.translation: Very good, how nice! Today the road is lovely and the sky is clear. Are you happy?
